name: standard-delivery
title: Standard Project Delivery
description: The core delivery tickets TSD creates for every new project: Project Setup, Project Management, Infrastructure setup, Third-party accounts and Transactional email in the core delivery, ending in a Build Complete milestone; and the Go-live Launch checks. Platform-neutral - apply umbraco-setup on top for Umbraco projects, and stripe-integration where the site takes payments.

variables.name: domain_name
variables.description: The project's primary domain name, e.g. example.com

variables.name: sprint_count
variables.description: Number of two-week sprints planned, e.g. 8 for a four-month project. One Show & Tell ticket is created per sprint.

variables.name: email_provider
variables.description: Transactional email provider. The default keeps tickets provider-neutral; name the one in use (e.g. Mailgun) to be specific.

variables.name: delivery_list
variables.description: Task list (project phase) for the core delivery

tasks.title: Project Setup
tasks.description: The early, one-off work that gets the project moving. Everything here should be done in the first week or two.

subtasks.title: Agree the Product Owners and Project Team
subtasks.description: Name the client-side Product Owner(s) - who prioritises the backlog and signs off work - and the TSD project team (delivery lead, developers, designer, QA). Record them on the project so everyone knows who decides what.

subtasks.title: Project Kick-off (internal)
subtasks.description: Brief the delivery team: scope, approach, roles, key dates, budget and known risks before any client-facing work starts.

subtasks.title: Project Kick-off (client)
subtasks.description: Align with the customer on goals, timeline, comms cadence, who signs off what, and how feedback/tickets flow.

subtasks.title: Create GitHub repo ({{domain_name}})
General project setup (Rider SLN files etc)
Set up the development environment
subtasks.description: Every developer on the project can clone, build and run the site locally: repository access, local database, configuration and secrets, and a CMS login. Document anything non-obvious in the README.

tasks.title: Project Management
tasks.description: Project management and ceremonies for the life of the project.

subtasks.title: Ticket Management
subtasks.description: Ongoing triage, refinement and prioritisation of the project's tickets.

subtasks.title: DSU / Regular Check-in
subtasks.description: Daily stand-up or regular check-in cadence for the project team.

subtasks.title: Project Planning
subtasks.description: Sprint/iteration planning and roadmap maintenance.

subtasks.title: Weekly client status update
subtasks.description: Short weekly summary to the customer: progress, what's next, decisions needed, and anything at risk. Keeps surprises out of invoicing conversations.

subtasks.title: Budget & burn-rate review
subtasks.description: Weekly check of logged time against budget in Productive. Flag early if the burn rate points at an overrun rather than discovering it at invoicing.

subtasks.title: Risks, assumptions & dependencies log
subtasks.description: Maintain a RAID log: risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies (customer content, third-party access, DNS control etc). Review it at planning sessions.

subtasks.title: Show & Tell: Sprint {{repeat_index}}
subtasks.description: End-of-sprint demo of progress to the customer. One ticket is created per planned two-week sprint; add more if the project runs longer.

subtasks.title: UAT coordination
subtasks.description: Agree the UAT window with the customer, provide a test plan/checklist, and capture their feedback as tickets rather than emails.

subtasks.title: Retrospective
subtasks.description: End-of-phase retrospective: what went well, what to improve.

subtasks.title: Project close-down
subtasks.description: Archive the project properly: final invoice check, remove temporary access/test accounts, ensure documentation and credentials are stored, move the project to support/retainer status.

subtasks.title: Post-launch review (30 days)
subtasks.description: Review the site with the customer a month after launch: analytics and search rankings, Seq errors, outstanding snags, and upsell/next-phase opportunities.

tasks.title: Infrastructure setup ({{domain_name}})
tasks.description: Environments, tooling and third-party accounts the build depends on.

subtasks.title: Set up CI/CD (AppVeyor/GitHub) ({{domain_name}})
Provision hosting
Provision database
Create Azure blob storage for media (CDN)
Setup Seq API Keys for UAT
subtasks.description: Create a UAT-specific API key in Seq and configure the test environment to log to it. Keys are per environment so noisy UAT logging can be filtered or throttled without touching production.

subtasks.title: Setup Seq API Keys for PROD
subtasks.description: Create a production API key in Seq and configure the live environment to log to it.

subtasks.title: Setup StatusCake monitoring against the test site
subtasks.description: Uptime check against the UAT/staging URL so hosting or deployment breakage shows up during the build, not at demo time. Remember UAT is often behind basic auth - allow the StatusCake check through or monitor a public health endpoint.

subtasks.title: Setup StatusCake monitoring against the live site
subtasks.description: Uptime and SSL certificate checks against https://{{domain_name}} with alerts to the support channel. Set up ahead of go-live so it's watching from the moment DNS switches.

tasks.title: Third-party accounts
tasks.description: Accounts the site depends on. Each one belongs to the client, with TSD given admin access - never created under a personal TSD login. On a rebuild, reuse the existing accounts so history carries over.

subtasks.title: Get or create the Google Tag Manager account
subtasks.description: If the client has a GTM account, request Publish access. Otherwise create the account and a web container for {{domain_name}} under the client's Google account and add TSD as an administrator.

subtasks.title: Get or create the Google Analytics (GA4) account
subtasks.description: If the client has a GA4 property, request Editor access. Otherwise create the account and property under the client's Google account, with a web data stream for {{domain_name}}. On a rebuild, keep the existing property so the traffic history carries over.

subtasks.title: Get or create the Microsoft Clarity account
subtasks.description: Get access to the client's Clarity project, or create one for {{domain_name}}. It's installed via GTM, and can be linked to GA4.

subtasks.title: Get or create the Google Search Console property
subtasks.description: Get Full access to the client's property, or create a domain property for {{domain_name}} verified by DNS TXT record. Do this early: Search Console only collects data from the day it's verified.

subtasks.title: Get or create the cookie consent platform account
subtasks.description: The consent platform (e.g. Cookiebot, CookieYes) must be in place before any tracking goes live. Configure Google Consent Mode v2 with GTM.

subtasks.title: Set up CreateSend mailing list account + API keys

tasks.title: Transactional email ({{email_provider}})
tasks.description: Outbound email for forms and notifications, sent through {{email_provider}}. The live configuration is in the Go-live Launch Feature.

subtasks.title: Set up the client in {{email_provider}}
subtasks.description: Create a sending domain for the client (e.g. mg.{{domain_name}}) with its own API key and SMTP credentials - never the shared agency key, so one client's sending reputation can't affect another's. Add the SPF and DKIM records {{email_provider}} provides to DNS and verify them.

subtasks.title: Get and share the incoming/outgoing SMTP server details
subtasks.description: Record the outgoing SMTP host, port, username and password, plus any incoming server or inbound routing details the site needs. Store them in LastPass and share them with the team; UAT uses them for test mail.

tasks.title: Build Complete
tasks.description: Milestone: the build is finished and the team is happy with the delivery. UAT starts from here.

tasks.title: Go-live Launch
tasks.description: The must-pass launch checks. Every task here is verified on the live site before the project is signed off.

subtasks.title: Ensure production licences are in place
subtasks.description: Check every licence the live site needs is purchased and installed **for the live domain** before DNS switches - domain-bound licences (e.g. Umbraco Commerce, Umbraco Forms, uSync Complete) that worked on UAT will not cover production. Confirm the licence files/keys are in the production deployment, not just a developer machine.

subtasks.title: Configure the live SMTP provider
subtasks.description: Switch production to the client's live {{email_provider}} credentials, confirm the sending domain is verified, and submit a real form on the live site to check the email arrives and isn't marked as spam.

subtasks.title: Update DNS settings
subtasks.description: Point {{domain_name}} at the new hosting. Check both WWW and non-WWW variations are set up.

subtasks.title: Check HTTP redirects to HTTPS
subtasks.description: http://{{domain_name}} must 301 to https://{{domain_name}}. Check a deep URL as well as the homepage, and confirm the certificate is valid for both www and non-www.

subtasks.title: Check www redirects to the non-www site
subtasks.description: https://www.{{domain_name}} must 301 to https://{{domain_name}} (single canonical hostname). Check a deep URL too - some configs only redirect the root.

subtasks.title: Ensure canonical URL redirects are set up
subtasks.description: One URL per page: lowercase enforced, trailing slash policy applied consistently, and old/legacy URLs redirecting to their new equivalents. Spot-check with the network tab that a canonical URL loads with **no** redirect and a non-canonical variant reaches it in a **single** 301 hop.

subtasks.title: Ensure Google Tag Manager is installed and firing
subtasks.description: Confirm the GTM container snippet is on every page template with the correct container ID, and use GTM preview mode against the live site to confirm the container loads and tags fire.

subtasks.title: Ensure GA4 is receiving data (via GTM)
subtasks.description: Check the GA4 tag fires from GTM (not a hard-coded gtag snippet) with the correct measurement ID, then confirm live traffic appears in GA4's Realtime report. Check internal/TSD IPs are excluded.

subtasks.title: Ensure Microsoft Clarity is recording (via GTM)
subtasks.description: Check the Clarity tag fires from GTM with the correct project ID and that sessions appear in the Clarity dashboard (recordings can lag a little behind).

subtasks.title: Ensure the site is configured in Google Search Console
subtasks.description: Verify the property for {{domain_name}} (domain property covers www/non-www and both protocols), submit the XML sitemap, and check for coverage errors once it starts processing.

subtasks.title: Ensure StatusCake is configured for the production URL
subtasks.description: The uptime and SSL checks must point at https://{{domain_name}} (not the pre-launch/holding URL) with alerts going to the support channel. Confirm a green check after DNS has switched.

subtasks.title: Ensure Seq is configured and logging
subtasks.description: Confirm production events for {{domain_name}} are arriving in Seq under the PROD API key after go-live, and that errors would alert - trigger a harmless test log entry if nothing has come through naturally.

subtasks.title: Put a live test transaction through (e-commerce only)
subtasks.description: Place a real low-value order on the live site with a TSD card against the live payment setup: payment appears in the provider's live dashboard, the order status updates via the live webhook, and the confirmation email sends. Then refund it. (This is the live smoke test from the stripe-integration template - skip here if that template is being worked.)
